variants.headline: Looking back: business plan abandoned before opening
variants.sub: The planned {business} will not open: {founder} has given up the plan.
variants.body:
We return to our earlier coverage. Our report recorded this: The founder {founder} had abandoned the plan for {business} before opening.

The person behind a business plan remains a person when it is abandoned. Labour should keep the household in view without treating a builder's work as though it never mattered. Fair treatment requires attention to the commitments on both sides, not an easy slogan about who ought to carry the disappointment.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

We defend {target} against an automatic verdict of failure in conduct. Abandonment can deserve a fair assessment, and the end of a plan does not establish every accusation about the choices surrounding it.
